description: This file defines the CoreDataNoteRepository class, which implements the NoteRepository protocol to manage notes stored in Core Data. It includes methods for creating, updating, deleting, fetching, and reconciling notes with remote data, utilizing background contexts and advanced fetch requests.

classes.name: CoreDataNoteRepository
classes.description: Final class implementing note persistence and synchronization logic using Core Data.

methods.name: createNote
methods.description: Asynchronously creates a new note with provided title and content, setting timestamps and initial sync status.

methods.name: upsertNote
methods.description: Inserts or updates a note in the database asynchronously.

methods.name: deleteNote
methods.description: Marks a note as deleted asynchronously by setting its isDeleted flag.

methods.name: fetchNotes
methods.description: Retrieves notes matching a query, sorted by last updated time.

methods.name: fetchDirtyNotes
methods.description: Fetches notes that have unsynced changes based on their sync status.

methods.name: markNotesSyncing
methods.description: Marks specified notes as currently syncing.

methods.name: markNotesClean
methods.description: Marks specified notes as synchronized with the remote server, updating their lastSyncedAt timestamp.

methods.name: markNotesFailed
methods.description: Marks specific notes as failed to sync, so they can be retried.

methods.name: reconcileRemoteNotes
methods.description: Merges remote notes into local storage, applying the last-write-wins policy, including tombstone handling.
